mutations.description: only one kind of locator is carried, so half the offers lose theirs
_note: PubMed's esummary never supplies a DOI and CORE has no PMID, so a
single-source locator silently strips the provenance from every
candidate that came from the other one. A title with no locator is a
claim; a title with one is checkable.
